name: profile_hotspot
description: A script profiled for real: a checksum loop that no static rule matches takes most of the time, while a list-based de-duplication is slow-looking but cheap at this size.

files.app/main.py:
from app.tools import checksum, dedupe

payload = bytes(range(256)) * 4000
for _ in range(3):
    checksum(payload)
dedupe(list(range(300)))
